body:
Manual reference for the extended work offsets. haas.cps line 22 says that G154 P is "not verified against Haas' manual here".

Haas Mill Operator's Manual 96-8000 rev V (January 2009, classic control), "G154 Select Work Coordinates P1-P99 (Group 12)", page 168:
- G154 with a P value from 1 to 99 selects one of 99 additional work offsets.
- G110 to G129 are the same work offsets as G154 P1 to P20.
- Macro variables: G154 P1 is #14001-#14006 (also #7001-#7006 and G110). The table continues to G154 P99 at #15961-#15966.

Thus the classic control has G154 P1-P99 as well as NGC.

A fact for probing: on one of our mills (a 2015 VF-2SS YT), the probe macros (G65 P9351 bore, P9359 surface) accept only W54-W59 and W110-W129, which is G154 P1-P20. A W60 gave alarm 503 ILLEGAL MACRO VARIABLE REFERENCE. So on such a machine a probe cycle cannot write to G154 P21-P99.

---
An agent (Claude Code) wrote this comment from our shop records, for LiamJDL.

Reference check against the Haas Mill Programming Workbook (the maker's training document; local copy, not attached).

- **G154 P1–P99 work offsets** (Preparatory "G" Codes List, p. 17; Work Coordinate Selection, p. 45): `G154 P1` through `G154 P99` selects extended work offsets `#7` through `#105` (mill software `12.02` and above). `G154 P1` through `G154 P20` select the same offsets as `G110` through `G129`. The control displays the active `G154 P` value on the Position page. **differs**: `haas.cps` sets `workOffsetMax = 6`, maps offsets `1`–`6` to `G54`–`G59`, and refuses higher numbers with `msg()`.
- **G10 programmable offset setting** (Preparatory "G" Codes List, p. 14): the summary table lists `G10` (Group 00, non-modal) with address letters `X`, `Y`, `Z`, `A`, `L`, `P`, and `R`. The workbook gives no detail on `L2` versus `L20` or `G154` `P` values. `G10 L20 Pn` format: **not covered by the workbook** (`haas.cps` currently writes `G10 L2 P1`–`P6` in `onProbeResult()`).
- **Probing macro variables (`#14001+`)**: the workbook does not cover macro variable numbers (`#5221+`, `#14001+`) or probing writes to extended offsets (**not covered by the workbook**; `haas.cps` currently reads `#5221 + 20 * (wcsIndex - 1)` for `G54`–`G59`).

Settled: `G154 P1`–`P99` is the Haas mill syntax for extended work offsets `#7`–`#105` (with `P1`–`P20` matching `G110`–`G129`). Still open: `G10 L20 Pn` syntax and probing macro writes to `G154 P1`–`P99` need verification from the Haas NGC operator's manual.
